description: T-1960: lifted TAKE/DROP over an array value, a lifted TAKE spilled and handed on, a 1x1 array in a lifted parameter, the unprobed M7 lift parameters, SORTBY's lifted sort_order elements and UNIQUE's by_col element. Column E (and T, V) holds each row's formula as text; F:S are ROWS, COLUMNS, and for each element (up to 3) INDEX(INDEX(..,i,1),1,1), ROWS, COLUMNS and SUM of INDEX(..,i,1)
